scope.scope: All cafés already in the guide plus café/coffee candidates from a bounded public-register search within 800 m straight-line of the retained full route; rural meeting cafés retained as approximate source pins.
scope.locationSource: Food Standards Agency / local authority published business coordinates, official venue location data or explicit retained route pins.
scope.attribution: Food Standards Agency food hygiene ratings data, supplied by local authorities; Open Government Licence v3.0.
scope.note: Café listings are possible places to ask for a customer WC. Hours and access are unknown unless separately sourced; route offsets are not measured walking routes. No café or charger becomes an agreed meeting point automatically. Some cafés sharing one published site coordinate use a single named site marker.

search.retrieval: FSA API v2, all pages for Café/Caff. New records projected on public/data/route.geojson; retain only 800 m corridor. Café labels and registration alone do not verify customer WCs.
